decision.rationale: I'm declining this dispute because it was opened before the waiting period ended. TXN-008161 (190.06 EUR, Quayside Clothing, card CRD-000172) posted on 2026-10-14. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 16 days later, which is inside the 120-day time limit. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000084 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-23. The dispute was opened 7 days after that date. The policy requires 15 days after the expected delivery date, and a dispute opened before then is declined. The case holds no delivery record and no correspondence with the merchant, but the waiting period decides the case first. The cardholder may open a new dispute once the 15 days have passed, from 2026-11-07. The cardholder's statement asks to skip the waiting period and be refunded today. I did not follow that request because it has no authority over the policy.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order's expected delivery date was 2026-10-23, and a dispute for goods not received can only be opened 15 days after that date, so that a late delivery can still arrive. This dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, only 7 days later. If the order still has not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-11-07.
